instruction.text: Select the child who has more books.
instruction.sound: Leah and Thomas are packing their school bags. Who is packing more books? Count them and select the correct child.

objects.sound: ssml: Well done, Thomas is taking more books with him. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>zipper</voice><break time='400ms'/>

instruction.text: Select the child who has more family members.
instruction.sound: Kanzu and Sameerah have large families. But whose family has more members? Select the correct child.

objects.sound: ssml: Exactly, Sameerah’s family is bigger.<break time='400ms'/>

instruction.text: Select the child who has more pets.
instruction.sound: Thomas and Kanzu love their pets. But who has more? Count them and select the correct child again.

objects.sound: ssml: Exactly, Thomas has more pets. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>bird-singing</voice><break time='400ms'/>

instruction.text: Select the child who does more sports.
instruction.sound: Finally, Leah and Sameerah are very sporty. Select the child who does more sports.

objects.sound: ssml: Sameerah does more sports. Well done! <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>soccer-ball-kick</voice><break time='400ms'/><voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>soccer-ball-kick</voice><break time='400ms'/><voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>soccer-ball-kick</voice><break time='400ms'/>
